meta.purpose: Paid media for the Makeborne 90-day plan: one simple card per ad the owner will actually run, in the order he runs them, plus a week-by-week spend calendar that reconciles to the $1,000. Companion to content/ads-playbook.md.
meta.planOfRecord: plan/strategy.md section 6 (budget lines b1-b9) and content/tracking.md section 7 (kill and scale). Where they disagree with this file, the plan wins.
meta.labels: [F] read at the platform page on 26 Oct 2026, [S] secondary, [V] vendor, [E] estimate, [A] assumption, [O] owner decision, [U] unverified
meta.status: Nothing here has been bought, created or launched. The owner opens every account, adds every payment method and presses every Publish button.
meta.howToRead: Each card has a one-line summary for the collapsed view (title, date, $, platform, audience); everything else is the expanded detail. Cards A01-A03 spend the $1,000 (lines b5 and b9). Cards A04-A07 are paid from revenue under owner decision D4 and are not part of the $1,000.
meta.inThe1000: Paid media inside the $1,000 is line b5 ($200: A01 + A02) and at most $52 of the reserve b9 (A03). Everything else in the $1,000 is creators, listings, the DM tool and fees (strategy 6.2); adCalendar lists all of it so the running total reaches $1,000.
meta.blackout: No paid ads from Fri 20 Nov to Wed 2 Dec 2026 (Black Friday prices).
meta.timeZone: All dates and times Europe/Sarajevo (CET, UTC+1). Create every ad account in this time zone and in USD.
meta.adCalendarDates: Each money item has the day it moves (date, or from-to for ads), from content/calendar.md "The $1,000, by date". The Today page shows it as today's money.

sharedRules.spendGate: No card launches until /go/ short links, first-touch storage and mb_src/mb_campaign/mb_aff on Makeborne-created Whop checkouts are live (strategy 6.1).
sharedRules.creativeGate: A post can be boosted only when it is 48+ hours old, has 3x the account median views, keeps 65%+ of viewers at 3 seconds, and has 1+ tracked sale on its /go/ code or 5+ link clicks per 1,000 views. Live features only; copy rules met.
sharedRules.links: Every ad links to makeborne.com/go/<code>. Never a Whop store, affiliate or tracking link. Leave the platform URL-parameter field empty: the /go/ redirect adds the UTMs.
sharedRules.copyRules: No free, trial, unlimited, print-ready, AI vendor names, competitor names or better-than claims. Prices say + tax. Real timers or sped up. No income promises.
sharedRules.killScaleShared: Kill a source at $100 with 0 net payers or $150 with 1. Pause it if more than 20% of its buyers refund within 14 days. Never fund above $120 CAC. Scale only at CAC <= $50 over 3+ net payers, +20% at most every 48-72 hours.
sharedRules.biHRule: Accounts in Makeborne's own legal name only. Never an account in someone else's name, a rented or bought account, a fake country or a VPN.
